brief:
Settlers began construction Thursday on a new outpost in the village of Al-Nuzla Al-Sharqiya north of Tulkarem, Shehab Wire reported. The group deployed approximately 20 prefabricated caravans across the site as part of the establishment effort.

Heavy machinery was actively clearing land and cutting access roads through the area. Workers simultaneously extended electricity lines to the developing settlement, with construction activity continuing throughout the day and into the evening hours as the outpost took shape on village land.
